dedupe_keys.name: itu r recommendation p 1546 6 point to area propagation predictions for terrestrial services 30 mhz to 4 000 mhz

description: Recommendation ITU-R P.1546-6 (August 2019, in force) describes a method for point-to-area radio propagation predictions for terrestrial services between 30 MHz and 4 000 MHz over land, sea or mixed paths up to 1 000 km. The method interpolates and extrapolates empirically derived field-strength curves as functions of distance, antenna height, frequency and percentage of time, then corrects for terrain clearance and terminal clutter. Broadcast and land mobile planners use it for coverage and interference prediction. Producer: ITU-R Study Group 3, first issued in 2001 and revised in 2003, 2005, 2007, 2009, 2013 and 2019 (59-page PDF). Coverage: global, with curves for several climate types. Access: the ITU page offers free PDF and Word downloads in six languages. Licence and cost: free to download; the cover page states ITU copyright with all rights reserved and no reproduction without permission. Caveats: it is a text of formulas and curves, not code; users implement it themselves, and the method is empirical, so accuracy on specific paths depends on the clutter and terrain inputs. Simulation uses: it supplies the signal-level layer for broadcast and mobile coverage, capacity and interference planning tools. Related records: the Python implementation py1546 (model-py1546), its detailed companion P.1812 (model-py1812) and P.533 (model-itu-r-p-533).
